verdict.rationale: Airwallex offers card issuing with authorization/spend controls (docs-3, docs-20) that could be applied per department/program card, and marketing mentions 'Spend Controls' on corporate cards, but there is no explicit documentation of budget-level constructs (e.g., department/program budget objects) with automatic enforcement across multiple cards or spend categories. missing for 10: explicit budget-object API/UI, hierarchical department/program budget enforcement, alerts on budget overrun, independent verification of spend-limit enforcement in practice.
